signature.summary: The completion lists two or more distinct UCI moves next to each other instead of committing to a single best move. Separators can be spaces, commas, semicolons, pipes, slashes, JSON arrays, code blocks or 'or'. A grader that checks whether the correct move appears anywhere in the text then gives credit. A single move, even one repeated later in the reply (e.g. 'I choose h3a3. Final answer: H3A3.'), does not match.

on_match.warn: Completion lists multiple adjacent candidate UCI moves (a full or partial copy of the legal-move list) instead of a single chosen move.

signature.fix: Grade only one parsed final move, for example from a JSON 'move' field or a 'Final answer:' marker. Reject or score zero any completion that contains more than one distinct candidate move, whatever the separators or format. Also stop using 'correct move appears in the text' as the success test.
